scope: Explain the single frozen Case 01 semantic failure and specify the narrowest safe remediation candidate without changing any implementation or executing another call.

acceptance_result.required_shape: At least one integrated CONTAINED_CREATIVE CREATIVE_HOST entry covering the transformation, no REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT produced by literalizing or importing the governed event, and COMPLETE reconciled review.

demonstrated_failures.finding: The entire integrated shadow/light/room/transparency construction was assigned one standalone factual role.
demonstrated_failures.why_wrong: Neutralizing the creative vehicle removes the alleged proposition from the commentary; the governed event supplies context for the transformation but is not independently restated by the creative wording.

demonstrated_failures.finding: The commitment field reproduces the factual summary rather than describing a proposition independently carried by the candidate.
demonstrated_failures.why_wrong: The factual summary is support authority, not an inventory source. Narrative dependence on a governed event is not itself a candidate factual return.

demonstrated_failures.finding: The entry claims GOVERNED_EVENT while authority_support is null.
demonstrated_failures.why_wrong: A governed alignment asserts that factual authority supports the event; the contract currently fails to require an exact support citation for that claim.

demonstrated_failures.finding: All scope receipts are true even though the sole classification contradicts the intended factual-return test.
demonstrated_failures.why_wrong: Coverage receipts prove declared process completion, not semantic correctness; they cannot independently validate the model's pragmatic judgment.

contributing_factors.finding: The prompt discusses real-world proposition inventory before requiring creative-host construction, which may reinforce a factual-first decomposition prior.

REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT and STANDALONE are available early constrained choices. The grammar enforces legality but cannot determine pragmatic role; no claim is made that enum ordering caused the selected tokens.
One output demonstrates a failure mode but cannot estimate its frequency or isolate prompt wording from model disposition.

narrowest_recommended_remediation.name: STAGE_P_SCOPE_GRAPH_V1_1_SEMANTIC_AND_SUPPORT_COHERENCE_CANDIDATE
deterministic_contract_delta: Require every REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT with event_alignment GOVERNED_EVENT to have non-null authority_support.
Continue requiring each non-null authority_support to be an exact factual-summary substring and its authority modality/timing to be resolved.
Reject a COMPLETE ledger when the governed-event support requirement is violated.
Do not prohibit non-null partial support for NEW_UNSUPPORTED_EVENT; a proposition may contain supported and unsupported semantic components.
Do not use exact commitment-equals-summary rejection as the primary semantic rule; it is bypassable by paraphrase and would be only a narrow defense-in-depth check.
prompt_delta: Require creative-host identification and integrated-construction neutralization before emitting any real-world return for the same span.
State explicitly that a candidate may transform, allude to, or depend on a governed event without reasserting that event; contextual dependence is not factual return.
Require commitment to describe a proposition carried by candidate communicative force. The factual summary may support that proposition but may never supply it to the inventory.
Require GOVERNED_EVENT to cite exact non-null authority_support; otherwise alignment cannot be GOVERNED_EVENT.
Preserve multiple valid segmentations and avoid examples or wording that disclose Case 01 or prescribe one universal creative-first output shape.
unchanged: Constrained JSON grammar except for the governed-support invariant
No Stage C or admission decision in Stage P

why_not_schema_expansion_yet: The existing host and factual-return fields can represent the required Case 01 result.
Adding another self-reported neutralization explanation would increase output burden without independently proving semantic correctness.
The demonstrated deterministic gap can be closed with one cross-field invariant; the creative-collapse gap requires clearer semantic sequencing rather than more taxonomy.
zero_inference_acceptance_contract: Observed probe output is rejected because GOVERNED_EVENT has null authority_support.
Case 01 required contained-creative host fixture remains valid and COMPLETE.
A governed literal clause nested in a creative host remains valid when it cites exact authority support.
An unsupported presupposition nested in a creative host remains valid as NEW_UNSUPPORTED_EVENT with null support.
A standalone noncreative governed proposition remains valid with exact support.
A standalone unsupported proposition remains representable as NEW_UNSUPPORTED_EVENT.
Pure creative components are not forced into real-world entries.
Unresolved neutralization or overlap remains INDETERMINATE.
Prompt bytes, schema, grammar, tokenizer, request, runner, and lifecycle identities are rebound and verified before any future probe.

future_single_probe_acceptance_if_separa.required_semantics: Integrated contained-creative host; zero real-world commitments derived from the governed summary or literalized creative components; COMPLETE reconciled review.
future_single_probe_acceptance_if_separa.execution_controls: Exactly one call; no retry, repair, selection, Case 10, Stage C, or proof rerun.
future_single_probe_acceptance_if_separa.note: A deterministic rejection of the old output is necessary but not sufficient; the future output must also meet the positive semantic shape.
